en.title: Explore research directions
en.description: Generate and compare research ideas with explicit assumptions and evaluation criteria.
tasks: Generate and compare research ideas with explicit assumptions and evaluation criteria.
prerequisites: A research question and background evidence; optional local helpers need Python 3.11+.
en.example: Use scientific-brainstorming. Propose five testable directions for this research question, then compare feasibility and evidence gaps.
en.expectedResult: An idea set, transparent comparison, and decision log for follow-up work.
limitations: Ideation does not establish empirical validity or replace study-design review.

zh.title: 探索研究方向
zh.description: 生成并比较研究想法，明确假设与评估标准。
tasks: 生成并比较研究想法，明确假设与评估标准。
prerequisites: 研究问题与背景证据；可选本地工具需 Python 3.11+。
zh.example: 请使用 scientific-brainstorming：为此研究问题提出五个可检验方向，并比较可行性与证据缺口。
zh.expectedResult: 候选想法、透明的对比过程及后续决策记录。
limitations: 构思不等于实证成立，也不能替代研究设计审查。
